title: Cross-mesh backbone (control plane)
objective: Replace 'gateway observes the whole other mesh' with a backbone gossip topic carrying per-mesh SUMMARIES (directory + aggregate metrics). Gateways aggregate their own mesh and publish; everyone reads summaries. Scales to hundreds of gateways/mesh; the admin-ui stops being a special all-mesh subscriber.
in_scope: Backbone topic: a dedicated iroh-gossip topic blake3("rafka.backbone") (reuse the gossip primitive; NO new mesh infra, NO DHT)
MeshSummary record: {mesh_id, directory[name->{type,location}], aggregate{node_count, cpu_used/budget, ram_used/budget, frames_per_sec}, published_by, wall_time_ms, expires_at_ms}
Aggregation on the gateway: sum its own mesh's live_digests() locally; assemble the directory; publish MeshSummary to the backbone each interval

Publisher selection = SOFT LEASE (NOT an election): publisher stamps published_by+expires_at and renews; others defer to a live claim; min(node_id) over live gateways ONLY breaks ties for a vacant/expired seat; failover when the claim expires (dead-man's switch). No consensus, no QUIC election.
Gateway cross-mesh write resolves the target location from the BACKBONE DIRECTORY (no longer joins the other mesh's full gossip)

admin-ui consumes the backbone for the global view (per-mesh aggregates+directory) + its home mesh's gossip for local per-node detail; remove the all-mesh RAFKA_OBSERVER_MESHES cross-subscription as the default cross-mesh path
Telemetry: rafka.mesh.backbone.published / .received spans + per-mesh aggregate metrics; add to CLAUDE.md §10 (append-only) in the same commit
out_of_scope: Any consensus / leader-election protocol, DHT, or self-organizing global cache
exit_criteria: A cross-mesh write resolves the target via the backbone directory while the gateway is NOT in the remote mesh's gossip (verify: gateway topic_membership has only its own mesh)
Exactly ONE publisher per mesh in steady state; kill the publisher -> another gateway takes over within ~TTL; no permanent double-publish
Scale: with N gateways in a mesh, backbone publish rate is ~1/mesh, not N/mesh
admin-ui shows per-mesh aggregates + directory sourced from the backbone (not all-mesh gossip)
rafka.mesh.backbone.published/.received visible in Jaeger; UI + Jaeger screenshots in docs/sprints/sprint-14/screenshots/; TEAM LEAD personally verified
sprint-release.md/.html with embedded screenshots + Jaeger/admin links, opened
depends_on: sprint-13 (telemetry hierarchy: service.name=<mesh>.<type>, W3C propagation, self-naming, mesh_id-required) lands first; the backbone summary uses those names
